## Historical audit — H0096

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane3/codex_parallel_08_lane3_B_r1/infer_logs/kea-atomic-signal-selectors/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event citations below refer to this file unless stated otherwise.

| Aspect | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Goal | The original task prompt is not visible. From the task name and reproduction, the apparent goal was atomic selector behavior and selector-health support; that is an inference, not a complete specification. The student tested `atomicSelectors: true` and a selector reading `user.name` (main_agent events 33–34). |
| Autonomous exploration | The student inspected selector construction, reducers, context, mounting, React hooks, and types (events 11–26), then explored wrappers and public types again (events 35–36). Existing selector construction used Reselect `createSelector` (event 12). |
| Changes | Creating a branch from `main` failed because the ref was invalid; creation from `master` succeeded (events 7–10). The final status/diff command output only the branch name, consistent with a clean tree (events 37–38). The student explicitly said no fix or commit was made (event 39). |
| Validation | Initial reproduction attempts failed because `@babel/register` was unavailable and TypeScript transpilation produced syntax errors (events 27–32). A Babel-based run then printed `initial A 1 health undefined` and `after unrelated change A 2`: the value stayed A while the evaluation counter increased (events 33–34). This is a narrow baseline reproduction, not validation of a fix. |
| Teacher input | The supplied inventory lists shared hint files and an actual-system-prompt path, but their contents are not supplied here. No delivered teacher text or adoption is visible in the events. Availability alone does not establish receipt. |
| Outcome | The supplied inventory reports a zero-byte patch, **formally not solved**, 0/12 fail-to-pass and 139/139 pass-to-pass tests. Those are reported evaluation counts, not evidence of an implemented solution. The run ended normally with `end_turn` (top-level metadata; event 39); the earlier tool errors were overcome rather than a terminal technical interruption. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, an isolated counter-based reproduction can distinguish unchanged output from unnecessary recomputation, and toolchain failures should be separated from the underlying behavior. Task-specifically, this run observed missing `selectorHealth` and recomputation after an age-only change, but did not establish the full desired API, root cause, or a correct algorithm. Why the student stopped without implementing a fix is not visible; neither teacher receipt nor influence can be determined from the supplied record.
